meta.name: Chidiya Udd
meta.description: Inspired by real incidents and based on a book Cages by Abid Surti - Chidiya Udd is a story of struggle and fighting all odds told from the eyes of the protagonist, a 20-year-old Seher, who hails from Rajasthan. We follow her journey to Mumbai with a dream of making it in the big city. Set against the backdrop of gang wars and a dark underbelly of crime, will Seher survive Bombay?

videos.title: A Runaway Life
videos.overview: Seher flees to Mumbai after a fight with Rana. She crashes an auction in Kamathipura, run by Resham and Habiba. Amid chaos over missing Neeti, Seher seizes her chance to present herself, defying Raju's earlier refusal.

videos.title: Shadows At Play
videos.overview: Seher saves Neeti from Akram's men but is shot. Baburao wins auction. Dr. Anand treats Seher, warns her to flee. Suraiyya caught escaping village. Quadir bribes Inspector Satpute. Seher's fate hangs in balance.

videos.title: Hunter And Prey
videos.overview: Akram hunts Seher. Dhananjay tortures Suraiyya for Seher's whereabouts. Baburao meets Ivy in Bangkok, plans to meet Chao Fa. Seher finds ally in Sattar. Raju bribes Inspector Satpute to eliminate Seher.

videos.title: Tale Of Betrayal
videos.overview: Police raid brothels for Seher. Dhananjay torments Suraiyya as Rana's health worsens. Seher escapes, accidentally kills Gafoor. Champa sells Seher to Habiba. Quadir favors Akram in lane distribution, angering Baburao post-Thailand trip.

videos.title: Secrets And Chains
videos.overview: Flashback reveals Baburao's rise in Kamathipura. Seher learns Champa sold her. Sattar takes ill Champa to Dr. Anand. Baburao starts massage parlor with Thai girls. Quadir investigates Gafoor's murder. Seher rescues minor children with Sattar and Inspector Prabha's help.

videos.title: Battle To Survive
videos.overview: Minors' rescue revealed. Akram shoots Gotya, blaming Baburao for Gafoor's death. Dhananjay misinformed of Seher's death. Habiba bailed; Prabha warned. Sattar and Seher fall in love. Baburao claims innocence to Quadir. Seher finds Champa dead.

videos.title: Memories And Scars
videos.overview: Flashback shows Seher-Champa bond. Seher informs Sattar of Champa's death. Dhananjay's men find Seher's photo. Baburao opens parlor with Ivy. Quadir requests meeting. Sattar shows Seher Mumbai. Seher calls Suraiyya; Dhananjay attacks her mid-call.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: Dhananjay intercepts Seher's call. Power struggles in Kamathipura intensify. Sattar has accident. Dhananjay kills Raju, seeks Seher. Resham plots against Akram. At cremation, chaos erupts. Season ends with Seher, Akram, and Quadir in armed standoff.
